decisions.internet: Dual stack and gdata/gdata from Samsung SER. Xiaomi product uses IPv4 and gdata/gdata; Xiaomi system has empty credentials.
decisions.mms: PAP, IPv4, mms/mms, http://mmsc:8002 and 10.10.10.10:8080 match extracted Samsung/Xiaomi.
decisions.ims: Dual stack, hidden; no bearer restriction.
decisions.ut: Samsung PS_ONLY_VOLTEREGIED and APN hos; enable experimental UT flag and route to hos. No XCAP/BSF host/port invented. IMS registration policy left at platform default.
decisions.video: No override: no explicit Megafon-specific enableServiceVilte or mmtel-video in examined Samsung/Xiaomi settings.
decisions.voicemail: No override; number not researched for this profile.
decisions.cleanup: No deletion of existing operator APNs.
decisions.epdg: Experimental static ePDG from Xiaomi MegaFon MBN; priority [0,1] follows Pixel carrier examples. Roaming-specific address, IPsec authentication, timers and entitlement unchanged.
